changed_worktree_relevant_findings.evidence: Public dialog result contract used by tests/test_options_preferences.py at lines 868, 981, 1009, 1069, 2390, 2475, and 2539.
QMainWindow invokes createPopupMenu through Qt's virtual dispatch; there is no required Python call site.
The nanobind PDF writer reads the assigned field. Observable assertions exist in tests/test_pdf_overlay_export.py and native validation tests.
The nanobind PDF writer reads x_axis_dx, x_axis_dy, y_axis_dx, and y_axis_dy. tests/test_pdf_oval_export.py verifies the values and rendered geometry.
PDFExporter writes the native visible-box origin under these keys and OSTCoordinateSystem reads them by key for CropBox-aware export coordinates.
The nanobind PDF writer reads strokes for ordinary /Ink annotations; Highlight export now uses its separate typed paths field. Native annotation tests verify /Ink remains unchanged.
The fields participate in generated dataclass equality and hashing so differently tinted page renders cannot share a cache entry. Vulture cannot observe generated dataclass consumers.
